content.text: Athakaawme, BAWIPA Cathut ni lawk a dei.
Talai heh kanîtho koehoi kanîloum totouh ka kaw.
Meihawinae kuep Zion hoi
Cathut teh a ang han.
Maimae Cathut tho vaiteh, duem awm mahoeh.
A hmalah hmai kang vaiteh, petkâkalup lah kahlî a tho han.
A taminaw lawkceng thai nahanlah,
lathueng lae kalvannaw kaw vaiteh, talai hai a kaw han.
Thuengnae lahoi kama koe lawkkamnae ka sak e ka tamikathoungnaw,
kai koe kamkhueng awh ati han.
Kalvannaw ni a lannae pâpho naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut ma roeroe heh lawkcengkung doeh.
Oe ka taminaw, thai awh haw, lawk ka dei vai.
Oe Isarel, nang taranlahoi ka dei han. Kai heh Cathut na Cathut doeh.
Nange thuengnae dawk na yue mahoeh.
Ka hmalah pout laipalah kaawm e hmaisawi thuengnae dawk
hai na yue mahoeh.
Na imthung e maitotan ka lat mahoeh.
Na saring thung e hmaetan hai ka lat mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ratu dawk e sarang pueng teh kaie doeh.
Mon 1,000 touh dawk ka pâ e moithangnaw hai kaie doeh.
Monsom e tavaca pueng ka panue.
Mon 1,000 touh dawk ka pâ e moithangnaw hai kaie doeh.
Ka vonhlam pawiteh nang koe ka dei mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, talaivan hoi a thung e kaawm e pueng teh kaie doeh.
Maitotan moi ka ca han namaw.
Hmae thi ka nei han namaw.
Lunghawilawkdeinae thuengnae hah Cathut koe poe haw.
Lathueng Poung koe na lawkkamnae hah kuep sak haw.
Runae na kâhmo navah kai hah na kaw haw.
Kai ni na rasa han, nang ni hai kai hah na bawilen sak han.
Hatei Cathut ni tamikathout koevah,
bangkongmaw ka coungnae hah na pâpho teh,
na pahni hoi ka lawkkam hah na pâpho.
Kaie yuenae hah na hmuhma teh,
ka lawk hah hnuklah na tâkhawng.
Tamru na hmu toteh tang na kamyawngkhai teh,
uicuknaw na hmu toteh tang na kambawngkhai.
Na kâko hah thoenae koe na hno teh,
na lai hah dumyennae koe bout na hno.
Na tahung teh, na hmaunawngha tounkhouknae lawk na dei.
Hottelah na o nahlangva kai ni duem na o takhai navah,
nama patetlah kai hah na pouk.
Hatei, na yue vaiteh na yonnae hah na hmaitung vah peng ka dan han.
Nangmouh Cathut na kapahnimnaw hetheh pouk awh haw.
Hoehpawiteh, kai ni koung na phi payon vaih.
Karasatkung na tawn mahoeh.
Lunghawilawkdeinae thuengnae ka sak e pueng teh,
kai ka bawilen sak e lah ao.
A cei nahan lamthung ka pouk e tami koe
Cathut e rungngangnae lamthung ka pâtue han.
